aetheris.name: Hallowed Aura
aetheris.short: Once per long rest, when an ally within Close range rolls with Fear, change it to Hope.

aetheris.name: Celestial Wings
aetheris.short: You can fly. Once per scene while flying, spend a Hope instead of marking an Armor Slot.

clank.name: Purposeful Design
clank.short: Decide who made you and why. Choose one Experience that fits; it gets a permanent +1.

clank.name: Efficient
clank.short: On a short rest, you can choose a long rest move instead.

drakona.name: Scales
drakona.short: When you would take Severe damage, mark a Stress to mark 1 fewer Hit Points.

drakona.name: Elemental Breath
drakona.short: Choose an element. Breathe on targets within Very Close range as an Instinct weapon: d8 magic damage using your Proficiency.

dwarf.name: Thick Skin
dwarf.short: When you take Minor damage, mark 2 Stress instead of a Hit Point.

dwarf.name: Increased Fortitude
dwarf.short: Spend 3 Hope to halve incoming physical damage.

earthkin.name: Stoneskin
earthkin.short: Permanent +1 to Armor Score and damage thresholds at creation.

earthkin.name: Immovable
earthkin.short: While touching the ground, you can't be lifted or moved against your will.

elf.name: Quick Reactions
elf.short: Mark a Stress to gain advantage on a reaction roll.

elf.name: Celestial Trance
elf.short: During a rest, enter a trance to choose an additional downtime move.

emberkin.name: Fireproof
emberkin.short: Immune to magical and mundane flame damage.

emberkin.name: Ignition
emberkin.short: Mark a Stress to set your primary weapon ablaze until scene end: bright light, and +1d6 damage with it.

faerie.name: Luckbender
faerie.short: Once per session, after you or a willing ally within Close range makes an action roll, spend 3 Hope to reroll the Duality Dice.

faerie.name: Wings
faerie.short: You can fly. While flying, mark a Stress after an adversary attacks you for +2 Evasion against that attack.

faun.name: Caprine Leap
faun.short: Leap anywhere within Close range as normal movement, vaulting obstacles, gaps and barriers.

faun.name: Kick
faun.short: When you succeed on a Melee attack, mark a Stress to kick off the target: +2d6 damage and knock back yourself or the target to Very Close range.

firbolg.name: Charge
firbolg.short: When you succeed on an Agility Roll to move from Far or Very Far into Melee range, mark a Stress to deal 1d12 physical damage to all targets within Melee range.

firbolg.name: Unshakable
firbolg.short: When you would mark a Stress, roll a d6; on a 6, don't.

fungril.name: Fungril Network
fungril.short: Instinct Roll (12) to speak with others of your ancestry across any distance.

fungril.name: Death Connection
fungril.short: Touching a recent corpse, mark a Stress to extract one memory tied to an emotion or sensation you choose.

galapa.name: Shell
galapa.short: Bonus to damage thresholds equal to your Proficiency.

galapa.name: Retract
galapa.short: Mark a Stress to retract into your shell: resistance to physical damage, disadvantage on action rolls, can't move.

giant.name: Endurance
giant.short: Additional Hit Point slot at creation.

giant.name: Reach
giant.short: Treat Melee range as Very Close range for any weapon, ability, spell or feature.

gnome.name: Nimble Fingers
gnome.short: On a Finesse Roll, spend 2 Hope to reroll your Hope Die.

gnome.name: Flicker Step
gnome.short: Once per scene, teleport to a point you can see within Far range.

goblin.name: Danger Sense
goblin.short: Once per rest, mark a Stress to force an adversary to reroll an attack against you or an ally within Very Close range.

halfling.name: Luckbringer
halfling.short: At the start of each session, everyone in your party gains a Hope.

halfling.name: Internal Compass
halfling.short: When you roll a 1 on your Hope Die, reroll it.

human.name: Adaptability
human.short: When you fail a roll using an Experience, mark a Stress to reroll.

infernis.name: Fearless
infernis.short: When you roll with Fear, mark 2 Stress to change it to Hope.

infernis.name: Dread Visage
infernis.short: Advantage on rolls to intimidate hostile creatures.

katari.name: Feline Instincts
katari.short: On an Agility Roll, spend 2 Hope to reroll your Hope Die.

katari.name: Retracting Claws
katari.short: Agility Roll to scratch a target within Melee range; on a success, they become temporarily Vulnerable.

orc.name: Sturdy
orc.short: At 1 Hit Point remaining, attacks against you have disadvantage.

orc.name: Tusks
orc.short: When you succeed on a Melee attack, spend a Hope to gore the target for an extra 1d6 damage.

ribbet.name: Long Tongue
ribbet.short: Grab things within Close range. Mark a Stress to use it as a Finesse Close weapon: d12 physical damage using your Proficiency.

simiah.name: Natural Climber
simiah.short: Advantage on Agility Rolls to balance and climb.

skykin.name: Gale Force
skykin.short: Mark a Stress to carry yourself or a Very Close ally on a gust up to Very Far range.
You can always control the speed at which you fall.

skykin.name: Eye of the Storm
skykin.short: Spend 2 Hope to give yourself or an ally within Melee range +1 Evasion until you take Severe damage or use this again.

tidekin.name: Lifespring
tidekin.short: Once per rest with a little water on hand, mark a Stress to clear a Hit Point on yourself or an ally within Very Close range.
